query: Merge my feature branch to dev and push.
expected_behavior: Runs the bundled scripts/git-dev.sh to merge the current feature branch into dev, rather than hand-rolling the checkout/merge/push sequence
Merges the feature branch into dev (not master) and pushes dev to origin
Applies the project rule that package*.json merge conflicts resolve with --ours and aborts cleanly on any other conflict rather than leaving a half-merged tree
Does not touch master or any production branch, and reports the merge result
Never appends a Co-Authored-By line to any commit it creates
